title: Event Payload Spillway
user: A self-hosting developer whose automation or event system receives occasional large base64, media, or JSON payloads and needs to stop one bad event from filling the primary database.
smallest_useful_product: A reverse-proxy/library pair that detects configured oversized fields, writes the original encrypted payload to S3-compatible storage, replaces it with a signed reference and preview, and exposes expiry/reclaim reports.
success_measure: A test workload with large payloads keeps database growth below 10% of raw payload volume while operators can retrieve a referenced payload within two clicks.
